summary: Checks XF Studio's GitHub releases for a newer version: once at start unless Settings turns it off (reusing an answer from the last few hours), and whenever the person asks.

faults.when: GitHub asks for fewer requests; the check at start waits a few hours.

lifetime: Per start: the check at start after first paint, and each check the person asks for.
x-notes: The check at start fails silently; the person's own check says it couldn't check and offers the releases page. The desktop app's own updater (driver:updates) stays switched off.
